about_the_game:
Thanks to well-invested obols, Charon, the ferryman of the Greek underworld, managed to upgrade his boat to a train and connect other afterlife destinations outside of Hades. You play as an employee of Charon, a Soul Train conductor.

Managing the route, checking tickets, and taking care of passengers are your responsibilities. Take control of the chaos on the train and in the stations, and be prepared for the unexpected along the way. There are many souls lost in the Afterlife who need your help. Interact with passengers, discover their stories, and find the most important one — the story of your past life and the answer to the question: are you one of those lost souls?

With cozy aesthetics, emotionally engaging storytelling, and immersive gameplay mechanics, Soul Express: Ticket to Afterlife offers a heartfelt journey of self-forgiveness and connection, wrapped in the soothing rhythm of a train ride through the beyond.


Features:

● A Personal Odyssey: Guide souls while piecing together your unfinished story of

love, loss, and forgiveness.

● Dynamic Gameplay: From ticket inspections to mini-games and exploring stations,

every task immerses you deeper into this vibrant afterlife.

● Stunning Isometric Art: A visually captivating world blending classical and modern

aesthetics with rich cultural inspirations.

● Unforgettable Characters: Build relationships with passengers and crew, each with

unique stories and personalities.

● Relaxed, Non-Urgent Progression: Play at your own pace; no pressure, only

discovery.

short_description: Soul Express: Ticket to Afterlife is a cozy narrative job simulator where you take on the role of an Afterlife Conductor. Check tickets, guide souls, uncover your forgotten past, and forge meaningful connections. Relax at your own pace, solving mysteries and mending the bonds of loveand loss.
